# Original drivers call global SETULB rather than numfort's module procedure.
foreach(source IN ITEMS driver1.f driver2.f driver3.f driver1.f90 driver2.f90 driver3.f90)
    get_filename_component(name "${source}" NAME_WE)
    get_filename_component(extension "${source}" LAST_EXT)
    if(extension STREQUAL ".f90")
        string(APPEND name _f90)
    else()
        string(APPEND name _f77)
    endif()
    set(target numfort_example_external_lbfgsb_${name})
    add_executable(${target} "${source}" ../lbfgsb.f ../linpack.f ../timer.f ../blas.f)
    target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE numfort::numfort)
    numfort_configure_compiler_options(${target} legacy)
endforeach()
